criterion: per-world bounded shared-gain joint-history profile chi2 <= best profile chi2 + 9
gain_rule: Different worlds may have different gains; each world's single gain is shared across all its old/new frequency/calibration blocks
material_definition: Exact original P2 concentric material decoder from four continuous coefficients; posthoc labels do not condition generation. R=1; relative epsilon dimensionless.

source_forward_bank.fields: full saved 625-by-6-by-32 Maxwell response bank, C flattening; required external evidence asset in same release

observation_replay: Exactly original Simulator.initial and measure(parent,noise,step-1,action) potential outcomes; no new noise drawn; original index0 occurs once

array_axes.history_values: Zero padded; slice to history_valid_real_channels. Original and fresh blocks are concatenated once, each block Re16/Im16 or one real calibration channel.

limitations: Finite coarse full625 catalogue may miss important worlds.
Heuristic delta9 mask has no calibrated coverage probability.
Outside-support and undiscovered-family mass is unquantified.
Different policies observe different action-indexed potential outcomes; they are not extra independent parents.
E2 reuses E1 parents as exposed followup.
Retaining one event does not prove a globally unique material; original complete catalogue is never discarded.
